newsitem.title: USA: Dell cuts U.S. prices on PowerEdge servers.
newsitem.headline: Dell cuts U.S. prices on PowerEdge servers.

text.p: Dell Computer Corp said Wednesday it would cut prices in the United States up to 16 percent on its mid-range and high-end Pentium Pro processor-based PowerEdge network servers.
Dell said it reduced prices on its mid-range, dual-processor PowerEdge 4100 and high-end, quad-processor PowerEdge 6100 because of recent cuts in industry component costs.

Dell Computer said its PowerEdge computers would now range from $5,049, instead of $5,399, for the PowerEdge 4100 with 180 MHz memory, to $22,239, instead of $25,239, for the PowerEdge 6100 with 2x200 MHz memory.
Dell shares were up 3/8 to 91-3/4 at midday on the Nasdaq.
